penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Building a vertical PM SaaS (even a lightweight one) requires meaningful onboarding, data migration support, and ongoing product iteration — not a simple Claude prompt plus Stripe link. The 'build' itself is non-trivial integration work beyond this factory's current standard tooling.

rationale: The buyer is well-defined — a 2–20 person web agency paying for Monday.com but finding it inadequate — and willingness to pay is demonstrated by existing spend. However, building a credible vertical PM tool for agencies managing 150+ client sites is a full product engineering effort (custom data models, retainer logic, multi-client views) that cannot be shipped as a Claude prompt plus landing page in a week; buildability_with_ai scores 5 and operational_autonomy scores 5, both below their respective build gate floors of 6 and 7. The gap between the strong commercial signal and the build complexity makes this a drop for this factory's current capabilities.
solution_plan: This opportunity has a genuinely strong commercial signal but is not the right fit for a solo non-technical operator using an autonomous Claude factory today. The product needed is a real SaaS with custom database schemas, retainer billing logic, and multi-client dashboards — requiring a developer or a no-code platform (Bubble, Glide) with significant configuration effort. Youval cannot build this without a technical co-founder or contractor. If the factory's tooling expands to include a managed no-code backend, revisit; for now, drop.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy build gate (scored 5, floor is 7). Fails buildability_with_ai build gate (scored 5, floor is 6). Total 4.5 is below validate threshold of 5.5 after penalty.
